fitMethod: Unsupervised fit on all training rows; injected labels excluded from features and fit
splitMethod: SHA256 of episodeId with fixed seed, 70/15/15; no episode crosses splits
thresholdMethod: 95th percentile of validation baseline anomaly scores only
limitations: Synthetic-only evaluation, not clinical or BPJS validation
Injected scenario labels are not confirmed fraud
No automatic approval, rejection, or payment
No patient age or identity used as features
